justification: Lot-area sanity guard on the flagship per-address brief: cross-check the VG valuation lot area against the Planning Portal cadastral polygon and distrust the valuation on material divergence (the 4,452 m2 aggregated-parcel case that fed a confident wrong area + capacity through the whole brief)

pre_impl.existing_data: lot_area_m2 was sourced ONLY from the VG valuation and marked AUTHORITATIVE with no check; the Planning Portal lot polygon (fetch_lot_geometry) plus calculate_lot_dimensions already yields a scale-corrected single-lot polygon area that can serve as an authoritative cross-check
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: the VG valuation parcel is not always one lot; it can aggregate multiple lots or resolve to the wrong parcel, so trusting it blindly produces a confident wrong area on the flagship report; the cadastral polygon is the better single-lot authority on divergence
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: new pure reconciliation helpers reusing the existing geometry fetch and dimension calculator; wired into both the non-streaming and streaming assembly paths before any consumer, with the streaming geometry await pulled forward so economics is not emitted with an unverified area

functions.name: _reconcile_lot_area
functions.input: valuation lot area, cadastral polygon area, and a relative tolerance fraction
functions.output: named tuple of chosen area, source label, diverged flag, and a note when they disagree
functions.if_none: missing or non-positive inputs fall back to whichever source is present, or none when both absent

functions.name: _apply_lot_area_reconciliation
functions.input: the valuation dict and the raw Planning Portal lot geometry for this address
functions.output: warning string for data_currency_warnings on divergence, mutating valuation in place otherwise None
functions.if_none: when geometry is absent the polygon area stays None and the valuation area is kept without a caveat

functions.name: _build_economics
functions.input: the valuation dict, now optionally carrying a lot_area_caveat from the reconciliation step
functions.output: Economics schema whose lot_area_m2 field is downgraded to DERIVED with the caveat when a mismatch was flagged
functions.if_none: no caveat keeps the field AUTHORITATIVE; a None area becomes NOT_AVAILABLE as before

values: N/A - no regulatory values are hardcoded; lot area is taken from live VG valuation or computed from the live Planning Portal polygon
queries: N/A - no new DB queries; the change reads already-fetched valuation and geometry results

break_it.scenario: Valuation returns an aggregated parcel far larger than the actual lot
break_it.what_happens: Without the guard the brief shows a confident wrong area and overstated capacity on the flagship report
break_it.how: On >25% divergence the geometry area wins, the field is downgraded to DERIVED, and a data_currency_warning is surfaced; covered by test_aggregated_parcel_diverges_and_trusts_geometry

break_it.scenario: Planning Portal lot geometry is missing for the address
break_it.what_happens: No cross-check is possible and a naive guard could blank the area
break_it.how: Geometry None leaves the valuation area in place with no caveat (test_no_geometry_keeps_valuation_returns_no_warning)

break_it.scenario: Streaming path emits the economics section before geometry is awaited
break_it.what_happens: The economics SSE event would carry an unverified valuation area
break_it.repro: Run _generate_brief_sse for an address whose valuation aggregates lots
break_it.how: The lot-geometry await + reconciliation were pulled forward to run before _build_economics in the streaming path; the later duplicate await was removed

break_it.scenario: Valuation and geometry agree within tolerance
break_it.what_happens: A too-eager guard would needlessly downgrade confidence on a correct area
break_it.how: Within-tolerance keeps the valuation area and AUTHORITATIVE confidence (test_agree_within_tolerance_keeps_valuation, test_no_caveat_stays_authoritative)

post_merge.manual_verify: Run the brief for the known 4,452 m2 Campsie address and a clean Inner West address: confirm the Campsie lot area now matches the cadastral polygon, shows DERIVED confidence with a caveat + data_currency_warning, while the Inner West address is unchanged at AUTHORITATIVE. RESIDUAL LIMIT: if geocoding resolves the wrong propId entirely, valuation and polygon can be wrong-but-agreeing and the guard will not catch it (separate geocode-accuracy issue, Bug list item).
